Check governing headings, definitions, exceptions and current source.","text":"Parents of British citizen children

C1861 [See Memo ADM 30/20] [See Memo ADM 07/21] [See Memo ADM 19/21] A person who is not

an “exempt person” has a derivative right to reside in the UK if1


1. they are the primary carer of a British citizen and


2. that British citizen is residing in the UK and


3. that British citizen would be unable to reside in


      3.1 the UK or


      3.2 another EEA state or Switzerland


      if the person (i.e. the primary carer) left the UK for an indefinite period.


                                                                        1 Imm (EEA) Regs 2016, reg 16(1) & (5)
